assertions.source: Same Sum y_l chi_l over the same nucleon chain; only whether the crossing `d` survives differs. Reproducing the habiro atomic value to this precision is what shows the divergence is the marshalling, not a convention.

assertions.name: d_preserving_reproduces_habiro_n

assertions.name: qu2w_fix_holds_marshalled_equals_d_preserving
assertions.source: (tau_p*tau_n)^2 ratio between the two paths. Before the qou-qu2w fix this was 2.157, matching the independently observed 0.34716 / 0.16097 and closing the chain from root cause to reported symptom. It is 1.0 once the marshaller stops dropping `d`, and a drift away from 1.0 means that defect has returned.

assertions.name: explicit_marshalling_is_still_lossy_p
assertions.source: Marshalling explicitly through marshal_to_chi_lambda_braid drops `d` on each nucleon's two `averaged` crossings. On the canonical word that moves the trace by 0.282 (p) / 0.126 (n). A collapse toward 0 means the marshaller stopped being lossy; a large jump means the crossing census changed.

description: Root-causes the 2.157x disagreement between the two canonical tr_M(4He) producers (bean qou-qu2w). NOT a convention difference: both are convention D and A=1 has no p-n interface. compute_tau_M_nucleon_H3 marshals through marshal_to_chi_lambda_braid, which drops each nucleon's TWO intra-nucleon `averaged` crossings to plain sigma (z - h/2 -> z). Preserving `d` over the same chains reproduces the habiro atomic values to ~1e-50.

root_cause.mechanism: routes the nucleon chain through canonical_braid_marshalling.marshal_to_chi_lambda_braid, which emits (sign, gen) and drops `d`; `averaged` maps to sign=+1, replacing that crossing's Markov factor z - h/2 by z at two sites per nucleon
root_cause.not_a_convention_issue: both producers are convention D (the habiro tr_M_in_q is rational in q, proton denominator 4q^9(q^2+1)^2); A=1 has no p-n interface so no pn_convention argument reaches this site
root_cause.why_it_hid: every audit keyed on `pn_convention` is structurally blind here, and the ratio differs between p (1.15346) and n (1.27316) so it does not look like a normalisation factor either
root_cause.available_fix: chi_monotone_transfer.chi_all_lambda preserves `d` and is validated against char_fast at n=6 and four cached oracles to n=12, all at 1e-50
root_cause.blast_radius: 13 direct importers of compute_tau_M_nucleon_H3; 46 modules in the closed_form_tau_M cone, including mass_table_comprehensive and nucleus_sdp_assembly — the canonical mass and binding path

caveats: This probe MEASURES the divergence and does not resolve it. Deciding which path is canonical moves every closed-form nucleon and atom trace in the corpus and is an owner decision.
